title: Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement
summary: ACTA was an intellectual property enforcement agreement led by Japan, the depositary. Australia, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Morocco, New Zealand, Singapore and the United States signed on 1 Oct 2011; the EU and 22 member states followed on 26 January 2012. Critics at a 2010 meeting said it threatened public interests.

where.modern_name: Tokyo, Japan (proxy pin: Japan is the depositary, and the EU signing ceremony was held there)
where.historical_name: Tokyo, Japan (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, EU signing ceremony)

importance.justification: A contested multilateral IP enforcement treaty that drew wide public criticism, but of limited lasting effect per these sources.
